lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nick 'The Nickel' is zip-tied to a chair in Sal's old concrete crypt[cite: 22, 23].

lines.speaker: NICK
lines.text: Your brother called us at 2:14 AM. Frankie sold you out for a stack of hundreds[cite: 23].

lines.speaker: FRANKIE
lines.text: I did it for the kids! Luca owes the Russians! Gina needs medical treatments[cite: 24]!
